notes.title: Scraftion is now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Soon you can play with your friends![/b]

[b]Multiplayer is coming soon, just for now Scraftion is single player. But it has Wan multiplayer connection.[/b]

[u]Remember that Scraftion is in Early Access and if you get an in-game error, turn it off with the console button and let us know. It won't be a critical error.[/u]
